products.name: iSANMATE PLA Transparent Filament 1.75 mm, Clear 3D Printer Filament, Suitable for High-Speed Printing, 1 KG*10 Spools
products.description:
iSANMATE PLA Transparent Filament 1.75 mm, Clear 3D Printer Filament, Suitable for High-Speed Printing, 1 KG*10 Spools
【High-Purity PLA Filament】iSANMATE Transparent PLA filament 1.75mm is made from renewable plant-based raw materials, giving it higher strength and toughness without warping. iSANMATE 3D printer filament is compatible with most FDM 3D printers on the market (the depth and brightness of the filament color depend on the model chosen for printing)
【Tips & Recommended Settings】💡Tip: ①If needed, dry the material at 50°C for 5–8 hours before printing; ②Adjust the wall thickness to control light transmission; ③Adjust the model size to control the color change. Recommended nozzle temperature: 190-220 °C; Bed temperature: 35-60 °C; Print speed: 30–300 mm/s
【Strong Layer Adhesion & Stable Printing】Made from high-quality PLA material, our 3D printer filament offers excellent layer adhesion, low shrinkage and strong adhesion to the print bed

Each spool is neatly wound and vacuum-sealed with a desiccant to reduce moisture absorption and prevent tangling
【Technical Solutions】We provide fast and efficient technical solutions for any printing problem – with a guaranteed response within 24 hours.

original.description:
iSANMATE PLA Transparent Filament 1,75 mm, Klares Filament 3D-Drucker, Geeignet für Hochgeschwindigkeitsdruck, 1 KG*10 Spule
【Hochreines PLA-Filament】iSANMATE Transparent pla filament 1.75mm wird aus nachwachsenden pflanzlichen Rohstoffen hergestellt, die eine höhere Festigkeit und Zähigkeit aufweisen und sich nicht verziehen. iSANMATE 3D-Druckerfilament ist für die meisten FDM 3D-Drucker auf dem Markt geeignet (Die Tiefe und Helligkeit der Filamentfarbe hängt von dem für den Druck gewählten Modell ab)
【Tipps & empfohlene Einstellungen】💡Tipp: ①Trocknen Sie das Material bei Bedarf vor dem Drucken 5–8 Stunden lang bei 50°C; ②Passen Sie die Wandstärke an, um die Lichtdurchlässigkeit zu regulieren; ③Passen Sie die Modellgröße an, um den Farbwechsel zu regulieren. Empfohlene Düsentemperatur: 190-220 °C; Betttemperatur: 35-60 °C; Druckgeschwindigkeit: 30–300 mm/s
【Starke Schichthaftung & stabiler Druck】Hergestellt aus hochwertigem PLA-Material, bietet unser 3D-Druckerfilament eine hervorragende Schichthaftung, geringe Schrumpfung und starke Haftung auf dem Druckbett
【Präziser Durchmesser & verwicklungsfreie Spule】Das PLA-Filament 1,75 mm wird mit einer strengen Durchmessertoleranz von 1,75 mm ±0,02 mm hergestellt und lässt sich reibungslos extrudieren, was für einen gleichmäßigen Fluss und eine zuverlässige Druckqualität sorgt. Jede Spule ist ordentlich aufgewickelt und vakuumversiegelt mit einem Trockenmittel, um die Feuchtigkeitsaufnahme zu reduzieren und Verwicklungen zu verhindern
【Technische Lösungen】Wir bieten Ihnen schnelle und effiziente technische Lösungen bei allen Druckproblemen – mit einer garantierten Antwort innerhalb von 24 Stunden.

products.name: iSANMATE TPU 85A Filament - Black
products.description:
iSANMATE TPU 85A Filament 1.75mm, 50-80mm/s High Speed Flexible TPU Filament
About iSANMATE: Our obsession with quality has led us to develop a variety of industry materials - covering all 3D printing consumables from everyday PLA,TPU,PETG,ABS,PA, to high-performance ones. We have devoted all the art we have mastered to the production of filament
TPU 85A Printing Settings
Drying: 80℃ for 5-8 hours before use
Printing Temp: 225℃ (recommended 225℃)
Bed Temp: 35℃ (recommended 35℃)
Print Speed: ≤80mm/s (50-80mm/s optimal)
Nozzle Size: 0.6mm ( TPU 85A is incompatible with 0.4mm nozzles)
Filament Dimensional Accuracy: 1.75mm +/- 0.03mm
Important Notice: When using TPU filament, pay attention to nozzle compatibility. Neither 0.2mm nozzles nor high-flow nozzles are suitable. Additionally, 85A TPU is incompatible with 0.4mm nozzles. Additionally, avoid using hot ends previously used for printing fiber-reinforced materials like CF Filament or GF Filament. Residual fibers from these materials significantly increase extrusion resistance and can easily cause clogs
Before use high-speed tpu filament , it is must to ensure proper drying
TPU material exhibits strong hygroscopic properties . Printing without drying may result in print quality issues
After printing, it is recommended to store the filament in a dry environment with relative humidity below 20% RH
Print Faster Without Sacrificing Performance Our high-speed TPU filament enables faster printing speeds while maintaining superior layer adhesion and a smooth surface finish. Ideal for prototypes, functional parts, and more delivering professional, consistent results every time.
Outstanding Mechanical Properties with Tensile Strength
Elongation at Break,Shore Hardness: HS tpu 95A / HS tpu 85A Built for flexibility and durability
Perfect for printing gaskets, phone cases, tool handles,ball,mechanical parts,coner protector, wearable devices, and any parts requiring resilience

products.name: PLA Glow in The Dark Filament 1KG - Green
products.description:
PLA Glow in The Dark Filament 1KG
🌟【Dazzling Glow, Shines Day and Night】iSANMATE glow-in-the-dark rainbow color PLA filament. It displays a stunning rainbow gradient under daylight, making your prints beautiful even before it gets dark. After absorbing sufficient light, it automatically emits a soft and long-lasting glow in the dark, requiring no power. This creates amazing visual magic, ensuring your creations stand out brilliantly both day and night
🌟【Wide Compatibility, Stable & Smooth Printing】Optimized for mainstream FDM 3D printers, it offers excellent compatibility with various brands like Creality, Anycubic, and Bambu Lab 3D Printers,AMS,AMSLite. With strict 1.75mm diameter tolerance control and minimal ovality, it ensures smooth feeding, prevents clogging, and helps you achieve high-success
🌟【Versatile Applications, Ignites Creativity】iSANMATE glow filament ideal for creating glow-in-the-dark toy models, custom keychains, home decor, and festival props, as well as safety signs and Halloween ornaments. This filament unlocks endless possibilities for creative design, STEM education, and DIY projects, turning your coolest ideas into vibrant reality
🌟【Strong & Durable, Excellent Quality】Made from premium raw materials, our filament produces models that are not only colorful but also possess the superior properties of PLA: high strength, good toughness, and low warping. With strong layer adhesion, your finished prints will have clear details and a smooth surface
🌟【Vacuum sealed packaging】iSANMATE 3d filament is carefully vacuum packed with desiccant to maintain the performance of PLA filament. And keep it dry to prevent dust and foreign matter from entering to prevent nozzle clogging
Specifications
Material
Glow in the dark filament
Printing speed
40 - 130mm/s
Printing temperature
190 ~ 220℃
Dimensional Accuracy
+/- 0.03 mm
Weight
1kg
Nozzle Size
0.4mm
Color
Glow Filament Multicolor, Green, Blue , Purple, Orange
Notes
Before you start to print the glow filament, Make sure you run a temperature bridge to find the best settings for your printer

Transparent Effect
The one-of-a-kind transparent flash effect imparts an extra touch of artistry and decoration to the printed models. Flash Point Effect
The transparent flash point filaments are meticulously designed to create a remarkable sense of transparency. They endow the printed works with a crystal-clear and brilliant luster, as if a dynamic layer of light and shadow has been delicately draped over them. This unique visual feature not only makes the objects look more appealing but also adds a sense of depth and dimension, making them truly remarkable pieces of art.
Neat Winding
Our filaments feature an impeccably neat winding design, free from any warping or bubbling issues. Even when the models are printed at high speeds, the surfaces remain extremely smooth and even. Every intricate detail is faithfully reproduced, showcasing the highest level of precision and craftsmanship. This ensures that whether it's a delicate miniature or a complex architectural structure, the final output is nothing short of perfection.
High Precision
Maintaining a stable tolerance within +/- 0.02mm, our filaments guarantee outstanding 3D printing results. The risk of clogging is effectively eliminated, providing a seamless printing experience. Moreover, the filaments are highly flexible, resistant to tangling and knotting. They can withstand repeated folding and bending without easily breaking, safeguarding the integrity of the printed models and allowing for the creation of intricate and durable designs.
Easy to Print
Our 1.75mm PLA filaments are engineered to be universally compatible, working flawlessly with 99% of FDM 3D printers and 3D pens on the market. This broad compatibility means that users can effortlessly bring their creative ideas to life, regardless of the specific equipment they own. Whether you're a professional designer, a hobbyist, or an educator, our filaments offer the convenience and reliability you need to explore the limitless possibilities of 3D printing. 
Package
We use vacuum packing and desiccant packing together to seal. This will make it easy to keep your 3D printer filament in an optimal storage condition.

products.name: iSANMATE PLA Transparent & Rainbow Filament - Transparent
products.description:
iSANMATE PLA Transparent Filament Product Description
Rich Colors
Currently, we offer a selection of 15 vibrant colors for you to choose from. Moreover, if you have a specific color in mind, simply let us know and we can provide you with OEM customization services, fully meeting your personalized creative needs and making your works truly unique.
Smooth Printing
Our filaments are free from winding issues. Even in the high-speed "berserk" printing mode, they can still achieve perfect printing results. It is undoubtedly the best choice for your high-speed printing projects, saving you time while ensuring outstanding quality.
High Precision
The tolerance is precisely and stably maintained within the range of +/- 0.02mm, effectively preventing clogging and ensuring excellent 3D printing effects. The material is environmentally friendly, with no bubbles or jamming during the printing process, allowing each creation to accurately reproduce your design blueprint.
High-Speed Printing
Thanks to our exclusive upgraded PLA transparent filament formula, the printing speed can reach up to 600mm/s, greatly enhancing your creative efficiency and quickly transforming the ideas in your mind into tangible physical models.
Wonderful Effects of Off and On
Whether in the "off" or "on" state, our PLA transparent filaments can display a charming clear rainbow effect, as if casting a spell on your works and injecting unique artistic charm, making them stand out among numerous works.
Excellent Light Transmittance
This PLA transparent filament boasts excellent light transmittance. When light passes through, it presents astonishing clarity and brightness, creating exquisite models with crystal-clear and intertwined light and shadow, adding visual impact.
Easy Printing
It has extremely strong versatility and can be compatible with 99% of conventional FDM 3D printers on the market. Whether you are a professional designer using high-end equipment or a novice enthusiast operating entry-level machines, you can easily handle it and embark on your creative journey.
3D Printing Model Performance
The filaments are neatly wound and will not clog the nozzle during printing, ensuring a smooth printing process and enabling the perfect formation of complex and delicate model structures, with every detail showing exquisiteness.
Vacuum Packaging
The elaborate vacuum packaging design effectively prevents moisture and oxidation, ensuring that the quality of the filaments you receive remains intact.

products.name: PLA Luminous Filament - Green
products.description:
Are the regular 3D printer filament colors too monotonous? Create unique and mesmerizing prints with our PLA Luminous Printer Filament. This filament glows green/blue/red in the dark, adding a touch of mystery to your creations. 
Get the ultimate 3D printing experience with PLA Luminous Printer Filament. Enjoy a clog-free, bubble-free and easy-to-use filament, while benefiting from its low warpage and high toughness. With the added feature of glowing in the dark, this is the perfect filament for all your printing needs.
Rest assured that our PLA Luminous Printer Filament is composed of safe and sustainable materials. It has been officially certified by CE and RoHS, proving its reliability and durability. The phosphorescent properties of this filament allow it to absorb and emit light in low light conditions. For optimal performance, we suggest exposing the printed model to sunlight or UV light for 15 minutes.
Upgrade your 3D printing game with PLA Luminous Printer Filament. With a diameter of 1.75mm and precision of +/- 0.03mm, it's compatible with most FDM 3D printers, including MK3, Ender 3, Monoprice FlashForge, and more. Increase your printing accuracy and efficiency with ease.
iSANMATE 3d filament is packaged with utmost care and sealed in vacuum with desiccant to preserve the quality of PLA filament. This ensures that it remains dry and free from dust and debris, preventing nozzle clogging.

♻【 High-Quality Filament】The 3D printer filament uses raw materials imported from Germany, it’s strong and durable, odor-free, with high purity, low shrinkage, good liquidity, and excellent adhesion. During the printing process, there will be no clogging, no warping, no tangles, and no bubbles, smooth feeding, and stable molding.

🛡【Upgraded High-speed PETG】The upgraded high-speed PETG filament printing speed can be up to 600mm/s without compromising the printing effect, it fits the latest high-speed printers and conventional printers on the market.

🧵【Vacuum Seal Packaging】Transparent PETG filament 1.75mm is completely wound by the machine and undergoes strict manual quality inspection to ensure that the clear PETG filament is not tangled. And the vacuum-sealed packaging with desiccant, to ensure complete dryness and no moisture.

🛠【Recommended Printing Settings】Recommended printing speed: 50-600mm/s, printing temperature: 220℃-260℃, hot bed temperature: 60℃-80℃.

products.description_html:
15% Carbon Fiber Filled Nylon: The material of iSANGHU Industrial PA12 CF come from Germany, is a composite filament material that is 15% carbon fiber filled and based on Nylon 12 (Polyamide 12). This carbon fiber reinforced material greatly enhances the material's overall performance and reduces the risk of warping during printing, allowing for printing in a non-heat preservation environment.

Excellent Mechanical Properties: iSANMATE PA12 CF has exceptional mechanical properties due to its advanced formulation using PA12 long-chain nylon and chopped carbon fibers. Our Smart Fiber Enhanced Technology ensures optimal dispersion and distribution of carbon fibers during extrusion, resulting in a mesh skeleton structure that bears most of the load transferred by the material matrix to improve mechanical properties, heat resistance, and dimensional stability.

Low Moisture Sensitivity & 194°C HDT.: PA12-CF has low moisture sensitivity, with only 0.88% saturation absorption rate, much lower than regular PA12 CF's 1.89%. After water absorption, its mechanical properties decrease by only 12%-18%, far better than regular PA12 CF's 40%-45%. This solves the problem of property and stability changes due to moisture. It also has a heat deflection temperature of 194°C, allowing printed parts to endure high temperatures without deformation or loss of strength.

Wide Industrial Applications: The carbon fiber filament 3d printing materials enable lightweight and durability, suitable for applications requiring torsional, tensile, and impact strength such as functional prototypes, tools, fixtures, end-use parts, pump impellers, mechanical gears, precision, and engineering components, widely used in robots, drones, automotive, aerospace and Medical industry.

Tips for Printing: The PA12-CF is highly abrasive, can wear out and clog stock 0.4mm brass nozzles rapidly. A larger diameter (0.6mm or more), abrasion-resistant hardened steel or ruby nozzles nozzle is highly recommended, and keep your nozzles clean between every several prints or so. For a better finish and layer adhesion, we would also suggest drying it before printing. Print Temp: 260°C - 290°C, Bed Temp: 90°C - 110°C, Print Speed: 40-60mm/s.

This carbon fiber-reinforced material greatly enhances the material's overall performance and reduces the risk of warping during printing.[Excellent Mechanical Properties]-iSANMATE's PA6-CF has exceptional mechanical properties due to its advanced formulation using high-quality Nylon and chopped carbon fibers. Our Smart Fiber Enhanced Technology ensures optimal dispersion and distribution of carbon fibers during extrusion, resulting in a mesh skeleton structure that bears most of the load transferred by the material matrix to improve mechanical properties, heat resistance, and dimensional stability.[Stable tolerance & Good Layer Adhesion]-Advanced CCD diameter measuring and self-adaptive control system in manufacturing ensure strict tolerances. Diameter 1.75mm, dimensional accuracy + / - 0.02 mm. The low shrinkage and stable printing dimensions make the fusion between the layers very good to obtain an even better-bridging result.[Wide Industrial Applications]-The carbon fiber filament 3d printing materials enable lightweight and durability, suitable for applications requiring torsional, tensile, and impact strength such as functional prototypes, tools, fixtures, end-use parts, pump impellers, mechanical gears, precision, and engineering components, widely used in robots, drones, automotive, aerospace and Medical industry.[Tips for Printing]-The PA6-CF is highly abrasive and can wear out and clog stock 0.4mm brass nozzles rapidly. The recommended drying temperature is 80 ℃ for 10 hours in a blast drying oven, or 90 ℃ for 12 hours on a heat bed before printing.
